verdict.rationale: Helicone is fundamentally an API/SDK-based proxy and observability layer — one-line SDK integration, REST API for queries, webhooks, and self-hosted Docker deployment all imply it can run without any UI, i.e., headlessly in scripts or pipelines. However, there is no explicit documentation or example of CI/CD usage, automated test pipelines, or headless agent orchestration specifically. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guide or example, documented non-interactive/automation-focused workflow, and independent confirmation of headless operation in production pipelines.
